limitations: Exploratory matched-seed sample. Prior and current input are rerun concurrently to reduce historical/API-time confounding. Fields-only arm uses the previous prompt to isolate the added fields; expanded also changes prompt and transition context. Expanded-refresh additionally interrupts a maneuver when a gate is passed. Physics pauses for API calls. No claim of statistical significance or internal model understanding. Input additions are a bundle, not per-feature tests.
